title: Cades Cove Riding Stables
specs: Scenic rides through Cades Cove in Great Smoky Mountains National Park
Wildlife viewing opportunities including black bears, deer, and turkeys
Minimum age 6 years old for horseback riding; riders under 18 must be accompanied by an adult
Minimum height 4 feet for horseback riding
Maximum weight 300 pounds for horseback riding
Riders must be able to mount/dismount independently and ride for five miles at walk/trot
No age or weight restrictions for carriage and hayrides
Group size limited to 9 riders per horseback ride; large groups over 9 must call
Carriage rides hold up to 6 passengers
Hayrides hold minimum 2 riders, up to 55 riders per hayride
